title: 10 Palms 30A
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “10 Palms 30A”, a luxury 10-bed, 8 full & 4 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 30 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Sky Lounge, Jumbotron, Elevator, & Golf Cart. Book your stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Easy Beach Access - Less than 5 Minute Walk - 6 seater Golf Cart & 10 adult Bikes - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Private Pool & Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $100 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Sky Lounge with Gulf Views - Game Room - Pool facing Jumbotron for entertainment - Outdoor Fireplaces - Elevator Welcome to 10 Palms 30A, an impressive Seagrove Beach retreat designed for unforgettable group getaways. Sleeping up to 30 guests across 10 bedrooms, with 8 full and 4 half baths, this spacious home is ideal for family vacations, celebrations, retreats, and large gatherings. Enjoy easy access to the Gulf, with Montigo Beach Access only about four minutes away, while Seaside, WaterColor, and popular local dining are all close by. The home pairs polished coastal style with comfortable spaces made for gathering. A bright great room opens to a beautifully appointed kitchen with a large island and generous dining area, creating an effortless space for everything from morning coffee to group dinners. Outside, the private backyard is made for vacation days, featuring an oversized pool and sitting spa, massive outdoor screen, firepits, and cornhole. Inside, guests can enjoy multiple king suites, a spacious bunk room with queen, full, and twin bunks, ping pong, poker, and shuffleboard. The fourth-floor sky lounge offers a wet bar and comfortable seating for enjoying Gulf Coast sunrises and sunsets, while the detached Carriage House provides two additional king bedrooms, a coffee bar, and private balcony. With 10 bikes, a low-speed vehicle, elevator, and on-site parking, 10 Palms offers everything needed for an easy, elevated 30A escape, close to the beach and packed with amenities to keep everyone entertained. Sleeping Arrangements FIRST FLOOR: - Master King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate SECOND FLOOR: - King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Additional Common Area: Poker Table and Shuffleboard THIRD FLOOR: - Master King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate - King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Full-over-Full Bunk Bed and 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only Additional Common Area: Ping Pong Table FOURTH FLOOR: -Sky Lounge with Gulf Views, Wet Bar with Upscale Lounge Seating CARRIAGE HOUSE: - King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only - King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only
